response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and systems programming, but this role is explicitly targeted at entry-level candidates with 'initial experience' who have just completed their degree. He is drastically overqualified, his primary expertise is in TypeScript/Node.js/DLang rather than Java, and his German is only basic despite the role requiring strong verbal and written communication in German. This is a significant seniority and language mismatch.
strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across many domains and technologies
Strong OOP fundamentals and familiarity with agile/craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Demonstrated ability to work with clients and lead technical initiatives
concerns: Vastly overqualified for an entry-level/junior position, likely to be unfulfilled or overpaid for the role
German is listed as only 'Basic', falling short of the required strong verbal and written communication
Minimal recent hands-on Java experience; current stack is TypeScript/Node.js, not aligned with core Java requirement
